admission.justification: A family that changed after judgment would silently govern under the old revision; the drift check forces the row to be named again with its effect.

applicability: Governing family rows after the family record's revision moves
conditions: The row records an older own revision
The family record stands at a newer revision in the candidate
exclusions: Member-only drift, which the existing member checks own
Frozen attempts, which a new attempt answers

evidence: Own revision9 drift, member coverage, repeated/later attempt, worklist and gate tests in the 224-test closure.

statement: Family governing-row currentness compares its recorded own revision with the current family and preserves member coverage and latest-row semantics.
